s0501.literal: In the ninth month, on jisi day, Venus infringed upon Shao Wei.
s0501.idiomatic: In the ninth month, on jisi day Venus infringed upon Shao Wei.

s0502.literal: On gengwu day Ahmad and others, citing military expenses and insufficient state revenues, requested re-establishment of nine chief transport commissions, proportionally increasing tax quotas above fixed amounts, casting ironware for sale through government shops, and prohibiting private manufacture of copper vessels.
s0502.idiomatic: On gengwu day Ahmad and others, citing war costs and short revenue, asked to restore nine chief transport commissions, raise tax quotas above fixed levels, cast ironware for government sale, and ban private copperworking.

s0503.literal: On yihai day warriors at Qinghe and Xincheng and those who died in battle were rewarded with one thousand taels of silver and one hundred ingots of paper money.
s0503.idiomatic: On yihai day Qinghe and Xincheng fighters and the fallen were rewarded with one thousand taels of silver and one hundred ingots of paper money.

s0504.literal: Garrison troops at Yacheng under the Prince of Xiping were granted three horses per man.
s0504.idiomatic: Yacheng garrison troops under the Prince of Xiping received three horses per man.

s0505.literal: On dingchou day five thousand eight hundred official oxen of Xiangyang were granted to the poor.
s0505.idiomatic: On dingchou day five thousand eight hundred official oxen from Xiangyang were given to the poor.

s0506.literal: The prohibition on selling horses in Henan was relaxed.
s0506.idiomatic: The ban on selling horses in Henan was lifted.

s0507.literal: Mongol garrison troops in Eastern and Western Chuan were granted grain and paper money in varying amounts.
s0507.idiomatic: Mongol garrison troops in Eastern and Western Chuan received grain and paper money in varying amounts.

s0508.literal: On wuyin day Director of Rites Hedan was instructed: "Last winter at sacrifice in the Great Temple an edict ordered that cattle not be used as victims; this is now restored.
s0508.idiomatic: On wuyin day Director of Rites Hedan was told, "Last winter at the Great Temple sacrifice an edict had removed cattle as victims; that is now restored.

s0509.literal: " On jimao day Venus infringed upon the Taiwei Western Rampart Senior General.
s0509.idiomatic: On jimao day Venus infringed upon the Taiwei Western Rampart Senior General.

s0510.literal: On renwu day Aju built Wantou Fort.
s0510.idiomatic: On renwu day Aju built Wantou Fort.

s0511.literal: On yiyou day the Xiangyang Army Command was abolished.
s0511.idiomatic: On yiyou day the Xiangyang army command was abolished.

s0512.literal: On jiawu day Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai led fifteen thousand infantry and cavalry to attack Wantou Fort; Aju and Atahai defeated them.
s0512.idiomatic: On jiawu day Song Yangzhou commander Jiang Cai led fifteen thousand foot and horse soldiers against Wantou Fort; Aju and Atahai beat them back.

s0513.literal: The Huai'an pacification commissioner Qirilishi and meritorious officers and soldiers were rewarded with brocade robes, silver, and paper money in varying amounts.
s0513.idiomatic: Huai'an pacification commissioner Qirilishi and meritorious officers and soldiers received brocade robes, silver, and paper money in varying amounts.

s0514.literal: On bingshen day Yush Timur was made Censor-in-Chief.
s0514.idiomatic: On bingshen day Yush Timur was made censor-in-chief.

s0515.literal: Printing blocks from Jiangnan prefectures and books including the Qiankun Treasure Canon from the Lin'an Secretariat were confiscated.
s0515.idiomatic: Printing blocks from Jiangnan prefectures and books including the Qiankun Treasure Canon from the Lin'an secretariat were seized.

s0516.literal: On the wuxu new moon in the tenth month of winter sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0516.idiomatic: On the wuxu new moon of the tenth month of winter sacrifice was performed at the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0517.literal: On xinchou day hunting prohibitions in Beijing, Yi, Jin, and other places were relaxed.
s0517.idiomatic: On xinchou day hunting bans in Beijing, Yi, Jin, and other places were lifted.

s0518.literal: On guichou day the moon infringed upon Bi.
s0518.idiomatic: On guichou day the moon infringed upon Bi.

s0519.literal: In the eleventh month, on dingmao day Ali Haiya led troops to attack Tanzhou.
s0519.idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on dingmao day Ali Haiya led troops against Tanzhou.

s0520.literal: On yihai day Bayan divided his army into three and marched on Lin'an;
s0520.idiomatic: On yihai day Bayan split his army into three columns and marched on Lin'an;

s0521.literal: Arighan led infantry and cavalry from Jiankang, Si'an, and Guangde out through Dusong Pass;
s0521.idiomatic: Arighan led foot and horse troops from Jiankang, Si'an, and Guangde through Dusong Pass;

s0522.literal: Dong Wenbing led naval forces along the coast toward Xupu and Ganpu, reaching Zhe River;
s0522.idiomatic: Dong Wenbing led the fleet along the coast toward Xupu and Ganpu and on to the Zhe River;

s0523.literal: Bayan and Atahai coordinated all forces by the central route, planning to converge at Lin'an.
s0523.idiomatic: Bayan and Atahai directed the central column, intending all three forces to meet at Lin'an.

s0524.literal: On bingzi day Song acting supervisors of Rong, Yi, and Qin prefectures Cen Congyi, frontier patrol commissioner and Guangxi military controller Li Weiping, and others came to surrender at the Yunnan Branch Secretariat.
s0524.idiomatic: On bingzi day Song acting supervisors of Rong, Yi, and Qin prefectures Cen Congyi, frontier patrol commissioner and Guangxi military controller Li Weiping, and others surrendered at the Yunnan branch secretariat.

s0525.literal: On dingchou day Ahmad memorialized establishing transport commissions on eleven routes in all.
s0525.idiomatic: On dingchou day Ahmad memorialized to establish transport commissions on eleven routes.

s0526.literal: On jimao day the armies under Song Du and others reached Longxing Prefecture; Song Jiangxi transport commissioner and prefect Liu Pan surrendered the city.
s0526.idiomatic: On jimao day the armies under Song Du and others reached Longxing Prefecture, and Song Jiangxi transport commissioner and prefect Liu Pan surrendered the city.

s0527.literal: The Grand Marshal's Headquarters issued proclamations urging Jiangxi prefectures to submit in succession, gaining six prefectures, four army districts, fifty-six counties, one million five hundred one thousand eight hundred twenty-nine households, and two million seven hundred six thousand four hundred persons.
s0527.idiomatic: The grand marshal's headquarters issued proclamations urging Jiangxi prefectures to submit in succession, gaining six prefectures, four army districts, fifty-six counties, one million five hundred one thousand eight hundred twenty-nine households, and two million seven hundred six thousand four hundred persons.

s0528.literal: On renwu day Bayan's main army reached Changzhou, directed the forces to scale the walls, and stormed the city from all sides.
s0528.idiomatic: On renwu day Bayan's main force reached Changzhou, ordered the troops to scale the walls, and took the city from all sides.

s0529.literal: Liu Shiyong changed clothes and fled south alone on horseback.
s0529.idiomatic: Liu Shiyong changed clothes and fled south alone on horseback.

s0530.literal: Shuntian Prefecture was renamed Baoding Prefecture.
s0530.idiomatic: Shuntian Prefecture was renamed Baoding Prefecture.

s0531.literal: The Privy Council stated: "Two thousand newly conscripted hunters of the Two Capitals and Pingluan are all poor and without means; their families should be supported.
s0531.idiomatic: The Privy Council reported, "Two thousand newly conscripted hunters of the Two Capitals and Pingluan are all poor and destitute; their families should be supported.

s0532.literal: Also in newly submitted prefectures and counties there are those who surrendered and rebelled again, and those who gathered bands as robbers and were guilty of capital crimes but have already confessed — we ask permission for summary disposition.
s0532.idiomatic: In newly submitted prefectures and counties there are also those who surrendered and rebelled again, and those who gathered bands as robbers and face capital charges but have already confessed — we ask leave for summary execution.

s0534.literal: Central Secretariat ministers deliberated on capital sentences; an edict stated: "Henceforth murderers shall die; once the charge is proven there is no need to await the season — execution should proceed at once.
s0534.idiomatic: Central Secretariat ministers deliberated on capital sentences; an edict declared, "Henceforth murderers shall die; once guilt is established there is no need to await the season — execution should proceed at once.

s0535.literal: Slaves who kill their masters shall be sentenced to the full five punishments.
s0535.idiomatic: Slaves who kill their masters shall receive the full five punishments.

s0536.literal: " On yiyou day Arighan took Guangde and pressed toward Dusong Pass.
s0536.idiomatic: On yiyou day Arighan took Guangde and pressed toward Dusong Pass.

s0537.literal: On bingxu day the moon infringed upon Xuanyuan's major star.
s0537.idiomatic: On bingxu day the moon infringed upon Xuanyuan's major star.

s0538.literal: On jichou day Director of Rites Hedan was dispatched to present three captured gilt bronze sacrificial vessels to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.
s0538.idiomatic: On jichou day Director of Rites Hedan was sent to present three captured gilt bronze sacrificial vessels to the Imperial Ancestral Temple.

s0539.literal: On gengyin day Bayan sent the defector You Jieshi as envoy to Song bearing a duplicate of the imperial letter, and also sent a letter instructing Song ministers.
s0539.idiomatic: On gengyin day Bayan sent the defector You Jieshi to Song with a duplicate of the imperial letter and also wrote to instruct Song ministers.

s0540.literal: On jiawu day, because Goryeo's official system had usurped titles excessively, envoys were sent with instructions that all office names and titles in provinces, commissions, censorates, and ministries resembling the court's were to be corrected.
s0540.idiomatic: On jiawu day, because Goryeo's official titles had grown presumptuous, envoys were sent ordering that provincial, commission, censorate, and ministry titles resembling the court's be corrected.

s0541.literal: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day Saturn infringed upon Kang.
s0541.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on wuxu day Saturn infringed upon Kang.

s0542.literal: On jihai day Zan Shun, associate of the Sichuan Branch Privy Council, stated: "Shaoqing Prefecture, Shizhou, Nanping, and the barbarian tribes Lu Gao, Ma Meng, A Yong, and others have a mind to submit.
s0542.idiomatic: On jihai day Zan Shun, associate of the Sichuan branch privy council, reported, "Shaoqing Prefecture, Shizhou, Nanping, and the barbarian tribes Lu Gao, Ma Meng, A Yong, and others are inclined to submit.

s0543.literal: Also Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian and Sizhou pacification commissioner Tian Jingxian — their loyalty is not yet known; we ask that edicts be issued enabling them to reform, with hereditary enfeoffment and titles permitted.
s0543.idiomatic: Bozhou pacification commissioner Yang Bangxian and Sizhou pacification commissioner Tian Jingxian have not yet shown where they stand; we ask that edicts be issued allowing them to reform, with hereditary enfeoffment and titles.

s0545.literal: On xinchou day Dong Wenbing's army halted at Xupu; Song commander Qi An surrendered with his command.
s0545.idiomatic: On xinchou day Dong Wenbing's army halted at Xupu, and Song commander Qi An surrendered with his command.

s0546.literal: The Song ruler wrote a letter; deputy envoy for relations with the neighboring state Yan Zhongfan's nephew Huan came to request peace.
s0546.idiomatic: The Song ruler wrote a letter, and deputy interstate envoy Yan Zhongfan's nephew Huan came to seek peace.

s0547.literal: On jiachen day Bayan halted at Pingjiang Prefecture; Song commander Wang Bangjie surrendered the city.
s0547.idiomatic: On jiachen day Bayan halted at Pingjiang Prefecture, and Song commander Wang Bangjie surrendered the city.

s0548.literal: On yisi day this year's land tax in Jiangling and other places was remitted.
s0548.idiomatic: On yisi day this year's land tax in Jiangling and other places was remitted.

s0549.literal: On dingwei day the relay-station directorate was renamed the Communications Bureau.
s0549.idiomatic: On dingwei day the relay-station directorate was renamed the communications bureau.

s0550.literal: On wushen day left chancellor Hududar together with civil and military officials inside and outside the court, clergy, and elders and commoners requested that the Emperor be given the honorific title Filial Emperor of Great Brilliance in Civil and Military Benevolence, Righteousness, and Culture Who Describes the Way and Obeys Heaven, and the Empress the title Empress of Bright Response in Auspicious Heaven and Sagacious Culture, Chaste, Kind, and Harmonious — not granted.
s0550.idiomatic: On wushen day left chancellor Hududar with civil and military officials, clergy, and elders and commoners asked that the Emperor take the honorific Filial Emperor of Great Brilliance in Civil and Military Benevolence, Righteousness, and Culture Who Describes the Way and Obeys Heaven, and the Empress the title Empress of Bright Response in Auspicious Heaven and Sagacious Culture, Chaste, Kind, and Harmonious — the request was refused.

s0552.literal: On gengzi day the Song ruler again sent ministers Xia Shilin and right recorder Lu Xiufu with a letter, styling himself nephew and begging for peace.
s0552.idiomatic: On gengzi day the Song ruler again sent ministers Xia Shilin and right recorder Lu Xiufu with a letter calling himself nephew and begging for peace.

s0553.literal: Zhao Long, magistrate of Cangxi in Western Chuan, sent a secret envoy into Song; an edict banished him to a distant place and confiscated his property.
s0553.idiomatic: Zhao Long, magistrate of Cangxi in Western Chuan, sent a secret envoy into Song; an edict banished him to a distant place and confiscated his household.

s0554.literal: On guihai day an edict to the Privy Council stated: "Jingzhou surrendered and rebelled again; it is now pacified — send the families of Vice-Prefect Zhang and Li Xin and those who rebelled with them to the capital.
s0554.idiomatic: On guihai day an edict to the Privy Council ordered, "Jingzhou surrendered and rebelled again; now that it is pacified, send the families of Vice-Prefect Zhang and Li Xin and those who rebelled with them to the capital.

s0555.literal: " On jiazi day a reply was sent to the Song ruler's letter ordering him to come and surrender.
s0555.idiomatic: On jiazi day a reply was sent to the Song ruler's letter ordering him to come and surrender.

s0556.literal: On bingyin day Arighan's army halted at Anji Prefecture; Song pacification commissioner Zhao Yike surrendered the city.
s0556.idiomatic: On bingyin day Arighan's army halted at Anji Prefecture, and Song pacification commissioner Zhao Yike surrendered the city.

s0557.literal: Goryeo's Dongning Prefecture was promoted to a route; Jiangdong's Nankang Route was transferred to Jiangxi Province; and the Mahu Route administration was established.
s0557.idiomatic: Goryeo's Dongning Prefecture was promoted to a route; Jiangdong's Nankang Route was placed under Jiangxi Province; and the Mahu Route administration was established.

s0558.literal: Longhua County of Chongqing Route was merged into Nanchuan; Haishan County of Luanzhou was merged into Changli County.
s0558.idiomatic: Longhua County of Chongqing Route was merged into Nanchuan, and Haishan County of Luanzhou into Changli County.

s0559.literal: Zheng County of Huazhou was restored.
s0559.idiomatic: Zheng County of Huazhou was restored.

s0560.literal: That year Weihui, Taiyuan, and other routes suffered drought; Hejian was damaged by rains — in all three thousand seven hundred forty-eight shi of rice and twenty-four thousand two hundred six shi of grain were issued in relief.
s0560.idiomatic: That year Weihui, Taiyuan, and other routes suffered drought and Hejian was damaged by rain; in all three thousand seven hundred forty-eight shi of rice and twenty-four thousand two hundred six shi of grain were issued in relief.

s0561.literal: Empire-wide households numbered four million seven hundred sixty-four thousand seventy-seven; sixty-eight persons were sentenced to death.
s0561.idiomatic: Empire-wide households numbered four million seven hundred sixty-four thousand seventy-seven, and sixty-eight persons were sentenced to death.
